# nemo_stack (List Resource)

The stacks a Docker has the records of, for `terraform query`: each, with its installations, ready to import.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `context` (String) A docker context to reach the Docker with, instead of `host`.
- `host` (String) The address of the Docker: `tcp://`, `ssh://user@host` or `unix://`. With neither `host` nor `context`, the provider's, with its `tls`; else the environment's.
